title: PixelKin - Title Theme (Lanterns to the Sky)
_note: The title-screen statement under the logo - the single most-heard melody in the game, so the hook is front-loaded and unmistakable. ASPIRATIONAL FANFARE reading of the Vesper motif (the G->C->D lift): punchy REPEATED staccato notes with little gaps - 'beat-beat-beat' - that leap from a low register up to a soaring high one and GAIN ALTITUDE each phrase (the leap-up target climbs G4 -> C5 -> E5 -> G5), the classic triumphant cartridge-title shape - reaching for the sky - written entirely as our own contour (never copying any real game's theme; see VISION.md). snes era (8 voices, warm reverb), bright C major, driving 120 BPM. A sustained string pad soars underneath the punchy lead, a driving eighth-note bass and a present backbeat give it propulsion, and a music-box bell sparkles in the gaps. 16-bar loop (~32s). Structure: A punchy rising call, A' the same up an octave (the peak), B a IV->V build, A'' resolves home; the final bar lands on the G dominant to voice-lead back into the C downbeat (seamless loop). Renders on the chip engine like the rest of the score for cohesion.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Punchy fanfare. Each phrase = repeated staccato notes (eighths) with a gap (rest), then a LEAP up to a higher repeated group or a held peak - and the leap target climbs each phrase so the tune gains altitude (G4->C5->E5->G5). A: the rising call. A': octave-up restatement, peaking on G5. B: a reaching IV->V build. A'': home, a triumphant descending arpeggio, then voice-lead down to the G dominant into bar 1.

tracks.name: pad
tracks._note: Warm sustained string bed that SOARS under the punchy lead - real triads (snes can stack) in the mid register so the harmony glows without mudding the tune. A stable, triumphant tonic-prolongation fanfare bed (C held, dropping to the G dominant to close each phrase), with a IV->V (F->G) lift in the B-section.

tracks.name: bass
tracks._note: Driving eighth-note root-fifth bass - the propulsion that makes the fanfare feel fast and forward. Roots track the C / G / F progression; final bar pedals G (dominant) to pull the loop back to the C downbeat.

tracks.name: drums
tracks._note: A driving backbeat to match the punch: kick on 1 & 3 with a push on the 'and of 3', snare on 2 & 4, hats on the eighths. A crash opens each big section (A', the B build, the home A''), and a small fill closes the loop seam. Each bar = 8 eighths.
